text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre was set to make her
Debut race at Niigata.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
My King, I have a report.
Regarding the gathered people's appraisal of you—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, this girl is Orfevre!
Dream Journey's little sister!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I've got my eye on! She was on a magazine
cover with Journey the other day.
She had some serious presence.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Journey's...? Guess I should
probably check it out then.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
—As expected, being the younger sister
of Lord Journey seems to be drawing
a great deal of attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey has achieved the great feat of back-to-back Grand Prix victories.
Normally, such a title would be a source of heavy pressure, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Good work.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh.
As expected of my elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre looks satisfied.
I can tell she respects her older sister.
And yet, she proclaims herself as King...
choice_data_list: Are you really satisfied with being just a "little sister"?
Are you okay with being the "little sister"?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: How shallow.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is proof of my sister's greatness as an Umamusume.
Why do you shrink from it?
choice_data_list: Still, based on your own evaluation—
Still, if it's your own evaluation—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of my sister
that the voices praising me grow even louder.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Do you not understand
that logic?
choice_data_list: Because I'll become even greater than my great sister...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then.
Bring forth the common folk."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The paddock, surely.
...Did you really think We would be put on display?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Standing alongside the rabble?
Utterly out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If they seek an audience,
let them make the journey themselves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—In my view,
the paddock is like a balcony.”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Just picture it. A dark, swelling sea of people,
all gathering just to catch a glimpse of Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Rather than treating the waiting room as an audience chamber,
would it not be far more delightful... to bask in the roaring cheers?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I shall proceed there in person.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
She really is adorable.
choice_data_list: Thank you for coming all the way to Niigata.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
After all, it's my precious little sister's debut race.
choice_data_list: Still, you're busy with races, aren't you?
Still, you're busy with races, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "For that very reason, I also wish to treasure our rest."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Besides... I need to keep the next journey in mind as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No. Let us go as well.
...So that we do not miss the beginning of a king.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! It's Orfevre. She's just as imposing in person...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hear me.
O masses.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...P-Peasantry?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Give thanks for your good fortune.
You are present for my activation.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you understand
your roles, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Shout with great cheer.
Lend your voices to bolster the path of supremacy that lies ahead.
